## H1: Local SEO for Salons in Mohali — Get More Bookings from Google

Mohali's beauty and grooming market is one of the most competitive in Punjab. Phase 7, Phase 11, the commercial belt along Kharar Road, the new sectors around Aerocity — every Phase has 30-50 salons, unisex studios and spas fighting for the same customers.

Most of these salons get found by word-of-mouth or Instagram. The ones that win — the ones with full books every Saturday — also get found on Google.

When a Mohali resident searches "best salon Phase 7" or "unisex parlour near me", the Google Maps 3-pack shows three businesses. If your salon isn't one of them, you're losing 20-40% of the new bookings in your area to whichever competitor is.

**Local SEO is the work of making your salon show up in those three results.** This page is a straight guide to what that means for Mohali salons specifically.

## Why Mohali salons are different from Chandigarh clinics

A salon is a "considered repeat purchase" business. That means:

1. **Reviews matter more than for almost any other niche** — clients trust the review count, the photos in reviews, and the recency of reviews. A salon with 220 reviews and a 4.6 average beats a salon with 60 reviews at 4.8, every time.
2. **Services are many and varied** — haircut, colour, facial, wax, threading, bridal, keratin, spa. Google needs every service listed on your GMB to show up for the right searches.
3. **Photo freshness is a ranking factor** — Google rewards salons that upload new photos weekly. A salon with photos from 2023 gets outranked by one with photos from this month.
4. **Booking flow matters** — Google's 3-pack listings now support "Book online" buttons. If yours isn't connected (to Booksy, Salonizd, Vagaro, your own site), you lose the click.

## What most Mohali salons get wrong

| Mistake | How many salons have it | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| GMB listing not claimed or only half-filled | ~65% | Invisible in Maps 3-pack |
| Service list on GMB is incomplete (5 services when you offer 30) | ~80% | Misses long-tail searches like "keratin treatment Mohali" |
| Review count below 100 | ~75% | Loses 3-pack to better-reviewed competitors |
| Photos older than 6 months | ~70% | Lower ranking + lower click-through |
| No "Book online" button linked | ~85% | Loses the booking to a competitor who has it |

By month 3, most Mohali salons we work with see **2-3× more Google calls and direction requests** and a meaningful uptick in new-client bookings.

## Who this is for (and isn't)

Local SEO works best for Mohali salons that:

- Have a physical location with foot traffic (not home-based or mobile-only)
- Offer services with margin (keratin, bridal, skin, hair colour — not just basic cuts)
- Are within 5-10 km of Phase 7 / Phase 11 / Aerocity / Kharar Road
- Want 30-100% more new-client bookings within 6 months

It is **not** ideal for home-based stylists (different playbook — Instagram + WhatsApp), or pure barbershops (low margin, different model).
